book.title: THE METAMORPHOSIS
book.subtitle: A CEFR A1 Educational Adaptation of Franz Kafka
book.author: Franz Kafka
book.adaptation_note_pt: Adaptação educacional com inglês simplificado. O enredo, a atmosfera sombria, os conflitos, a filosofia e o final da obra são preservados.

week.title: Behind the Door
week.main_language_focus: There is / There are + Prepositions of Place

opening_illustration.alt_text: The chief clerk stands near Gregor's closed bedroom door. Grete, Mrs. Samsa and Mr. Samsa are behind him in the hallway. Everyone looks tense and worried.

part_illustrations.alt_text: The chief clerk waits beside Gregor's closed bedroom door while the worried Samsa family stands behind him.
Gregor turns the key in the bedroom door with his mouth while his family waits outside.
Gregor appears in the open doorway and the chief clerk and his family react with fear.
The frightened chief clerk runs toward the apartment entrance while looking back at Gregor.
Mr. Samsa uses a walking stick and folded newspaper to force Gregor back toward the bedroom.
Gregor is alone in the dim bedroom after his father closes the door again.

before_you_read: Is it easy to understand someone when you are afraid?
Can a person's appearance change how other people treat them?
What do you do when you have a problem and people do not understand you?
story: The chief clerk is inside the Samsa apartment.
Gregor is still in his bedroom.
There is a closed door between them.
“Gregor, what is happening? You are late for work.”
“Your work is not good recently. Your manager is worried.”
He does not want to lose his job.
The people outside the room cannot understand him well.
Gregor tries to get out of bed again.
This time, he falls onto the floor.
He moves slowly across the room.
The door is in front of him.
There is a key in the lock.
Gregor cannot use his hands now.
Opening the door is very difficult.
Outside the room, his mother is worried.
The chief clerk continues talking about work.
Gregor tries to turn the key with his mouth.
Grete looks at her brother in fear.
The chief clerk looks at Gregor and begins to move away.
But his words sound different now.
Gregor looks at the chief clerk.
He does not want the man to leave.
If the clerk returns to the office, Gregor knows there will be more problems.
He moves toward the apartment door.
He wants the clerk to understand.
Gregor is still thinking about his job.
He still wants to show that he is Gregor Samsa.
But his father does not listen.
Mr. Samsa takes a walking stick and a newspaper.
His father wants him back inside the bedroom.
His new body does not move like a human body.
His father continues to move toward him.
He slowly returns to the doorway.
Gregor tries to enter the room.
His body gets caught for a moment.
His father continues to force him inside.
Finally, Gregor falls into the bedroom.
A few minutes before, he was worried about a train.
He was worried about being late.
He was worried about his manager.
Now the chief clerk has seen him.
But the people around him no longer look at him in the same way.
And this time, everything is different.

visual_reflection.title: The Door Opens
visual_reflection.alt_text: Gregor appears at the bedroom doorway in his transformed insect-like body. The chief clerk moves away in fear. Mrs. Samsa, Mr. Samsa and Grete react with shock in the brighter hallway.
questions: What do the characters' faces and positions show?

items: Gregor uses the ______ to open the door.
The chief clerk is ______ of Gregor.

reading_comprehension.question: Who is inside the Samsa apartment?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: The chief clerk is inside the apartment.

reading_comprehension.question: Why is the chief clerk there?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: Because Gregor is late for work and did not go to the office.

reading_comprehension.question: Why is Gregor afraid of losing his job?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: Because his family needs his money.

reading_comprehension.question: How does Gregor open the door?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: He turns the key with his mouth.

reading_comprehension.question: What happens when the family sees Gregor?
Why does Gregor want to follow the chief clerk?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: He wants to explain the situation and protect his job.

reading_comprehension.question: Does the chief clerk understand Gregor?
How does Mr. Samsa react?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: He becomes angry and forces Gregor back into the bedroom.

reading_comprehension.question: What happens when Gregor tries to return to the bedroom?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: He gets caught in the doorway and is hurt.

reading_comprehension.question: Gregor is still worried about his job after everyone sees him. What does this tell us about him?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: Open answer. Expected idea: he feels responsible for his family and is still focused on work and duty.

true_false.statement: The chief clerk comes because Gregor is late for work.
Gregor's family understands his voice perfectly.
The chief clerk is afraid when he sees Gregor.
Gregor wants the chief clerk to stay.
Mr. Samsa helps Gregor speak to the clerk.
Gregor is hurt when he returns to his bedroom.

reflection.title: Think About the Story
reflection.prompt: Is Gregor still the same person inside?

grammar_focus.title: There is / There are + Prepositions of Place
grammar_focus.explanation: We use there is and there are to say that something or someone exists in a place.
examples: There is a door in front of Gregor.
There is a key in the lock.
There are people outside the bedroom.
There are three members of Gregor's family near the room.

prepositions.example: His family is outside the room.
Mr. Samsa is near the doorway.
The door is in front of Gregor.
Grete is next to her mother.

items: ______ a chief clerk in the apartment.
Gregor is ______ the closed door before he opens it.
The door is ______ Gregor when he crosses the room.

look_at_the_scene.instruction: Use the illustration to make sentences.
look_at_the_scene.example: There is a door between Gregor and his family.

speaking_mission.title: What Is Happening?
speaking_mission.instruction: Look at the illustration and describe the scene.
speaking_mission.challenge: Why does the chief clerk run away?

writing_mission.title: The Door Opens
writing_mission.instruction: Write about the moment Gregor opens the door.

questions: Who wants to move away from Gregor?
What does physical distance tell us about the characters?

kafkas_question.context: Gregor wants to talk and explain, but nobody understands him. The people around him react to what they see, not to what Gregor thinks or feels.
kafkas_question.prompt: If Gregor thinks and feels like Gregor, is he still Gregor?
sentence_starters: I think he is still Gregor because...
I think he is different because...

second_question.context: Before his transformation, Gregor is important because he works, earns money and helps his family. Now he cannot work.
second_question.prompt: Will his family treat him differently now?

prediction.context: Gregor is alone inside his bedroom again. He cannot work. His family is afraid of him. But they still live in the same apartment.
prediction.question: What do you think happens next?

learning_outcomes: Describe where people and objects are.
Understand the family's first reaction to Gregor.
Identify the beginning of Gregor's isolation.
Think about the difference between appearance and identity.

next_week.teaser: Gregor cannot go outside. He cannot work. But someone in the family will begin to take care of him. Grete enters Gregor's new world.
